يقود العهد الجديد موضوع الهيكل إلى المسي: The New Testament leads the theme of the temple to Christ and His body, and then to the community of believers as the temple of the Holy Spirit.
يمثل دانيال نموذجًا مهمًا لفهم حياة المؤ: Daniel represents an important model for understanding the life of the believer in the midst of exile. He moved from the environment of Jerusalem to the heart of the Babylonian Empire, yet he did not allow Babylon to erase his faithfulness to God.
يمكن أن يكون لدينا «هيكل» عظيم من الخارج: We may have a great "temple" outwardly, but the real problem lies in the heart.
It can be built, destroyed, and burned.
